fix(ui): the fold hold asks for a frame only on a change

egui_dock clamps a split fraction after each layout, so the hold is
written on every frame and is not a change. The kit test takes the
font atlas delta.

Refs #4483

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ui): fold chips keep the safety state; review fixes

- The Browser chip counts blocked, stale and not generated operations;
  the Properties chip names the open operation's state ("Up to date",
  "Needs regenerate"), as text with a glyph.
- The chip tooltip follows the pointer.
- The chip hover is a 2 px accent frame and a full-ink title, with a
  contrast test in both themes.
- Tests: the stale count and the operation state on folded chips, and a
  fold does not move the camera.
- The decision file notes the viewport arrow and the separator snap-back.

Refs #4483

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(ui): shell.rs keeps its CRLF line ends

A scripted edit wrote the file with LF ends, so the PR diff showed every
line and conflicted with each other change to the file. The content is
the same.

Fixes #4483

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ui): fold chips keep a glyph when short, count warnings, test Blocked and Not generated

A chip whose pane is too short for the state text now paints the glyph
alone. The Browser chip counts the cached toolpath warnings. Tests pin
the short chip, and the blocked and never-generated states on both chips.
The decision file says why a multi-tab leaf shows its active tab only.
